def fn(x):
    res = []
    for ch in x:
        if 'a' <= ch <= 'z':
            # mirror in lowercase alphabet
            res.append(chr(ord('a') + (25 - (ord(ch) - ord('a')))))
        elif 'A' <= ch <= 'Z':
            # mirror in uppercase alphabet
            res.append(chr(ord('A') + (25 - (ord(ch) - ord('A')))))
        else:
            # leave any other character unchanged
            res.append(ch)
    return ''.join(res)
